sources.title: Aikwed/pistar06_insert_carrot_into_the_hole_acp_r1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pi0.5 ACP Policy — Insert Carrot into the Hole This repository contains a Pi0.5 action policy fine-tuned for the task "insert carrot into the hole" with the Advantage-Conditioned Policy (ACP) stage of the MINT-SJTU/Evo-RL pipeline. Despite pistar06 appearing in the repository name, this is not a Pi 0.6 value model.

sources.snippet: PiStar Data Closed Loop PiStar is not a one-time training pipeline. In general, you first train an initial policy with demo data, then use the policy to generate new data through rollout, and then merge the demo and rollout data.
